messages:
Ana M: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a deploy at 10:30 PT to adjust routing weights and ship a small observability dashboard refresh. Plan ~15m, canary 5m. :clock10:
Sasha P: Ack. I'll be watching dashboards & traces. What panels changed?
Ana M: Added a couple small panels and adjusted alert thresholds: qcache hit rate panel, hot-kv p50/p99 latency, and a trace sampling bump for the canary. Also tightened qcache_miss_rate alert from 10% -> 8% during the canary window.
Kevin L: Can you paste the exact alert rule so I can update the runbook?
Ana M: Sure — new rule:
```
alert: QCacheMissHigh
expr: sum(rate(qcache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(qcache_requests_total[5m])) > 0.08
for: 5m
severity: page
```
Sasha P: OK. I'll route canary alerts to the 'canary' notification group and suppress noisy infra alerts for 10m.
Derek R: Who is owner for rollback? I can be on standby to cut the previous image and revert weights.
Ana M: Thanks — Derek, please hold the rollback window. Rollback triggers are: hot-kv p99 > 300ms OR global error rate > 1% during canary. Smoke checks before promotion:
- `GET /health` on 5 hosts (expect 200)
- tail `router` logs for 2m (watch for 5xx spikes)
- run sample trace for happy-path endpoint and verify span durations < 120ms

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (revision: r2025-11-06-3) — 10:30:12 PT
observability-bot: Dashboard 'routing-overview' updated: panels added: qcache_hit_rate, hot_kv_latency_p50_p99; trace sampling increased 10% for spans tagged `route:canary`.
Sasha P: Running first smoke now — health 5/5, no 5xx in tail. Traces look clean so far.
Kevin L: Runbook updated with the new alert rule and explicit rollback steps.
Ana M: If anything looks off ping @Derek R and he'll cut rollback. Otherwise we'll let canary finish and promote at 10:45 PT.
Derek R: I'll be ready on the rollback playbook.
Ana M: Promotion scheduled for 10:45 PT unless we see regressions. :thumbsup:
Sasha P: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary finished — 10:40:03 PT. Traffic ramped per policy (5% -> 100% in staged increments).
Ana M: Promoted to stable at 10:45 PT. Marking deploy complete; will monitor for 30m for regressions.
observability-bot: Alert 'QCacheMissHigh' created and routed to 'oncall-canary' for a 15m review window.
Kevin L: Noted. I'll watch for any cost impact from the increased tracing sampling over the next hour.
